student_learning_goal: I can fix a bug by altering the code.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can fix a bug by altering the code.
header.character_watermark: Buzz in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Fix 6 buggy codes. Show your alteration. Verify by re-tracing.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Six fix-it rows.

image_placeholders.description: Six fix-it rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 4in. Each: original buggy code + 'My fix: ___' + 'Verified: yes/no'. Header 'Fix the Bug:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P1_FIX: keywords (fix) name the rows.

parts.student_instructions: Identify and fix bugs in 4 short codes (mixed types).
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Four mixed-bug rows.

image_placeholders.description: Four mixed-bug rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each: code, type (number/step/order), fix. Header 'Mixed Bugs:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P2_MIXED: keywords (mixed) name the rows.

parts.student_instructions: Take a partner's bug. Find. Fix. Verify.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Blank fix area.

image_placeholders.description: A blank fix area in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. 'Partner's bug: ___'. 'My fix: ___'. 'Verified: ___'. Header 'Partner Bug:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P3_PARTNER: keywords (partner) name the area.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, plant a NEW bug in a fixed code.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 worksheet. Watch for wrong-fix trap.
